sites.name: Prambanan Temple Compounds
sites.what: Hindu temple complex on the Yogyakarta and Central Java border, with Lumbung, Bubrah and Sewu temples on the same ticket (UNESCO World Heritage).

access.tickets: Book on the operator's official ticket site; one ticket covers Prambanan, Lumbung, Bubrah, Sewu and the Prambanan Museum. Foreign adults IDR 400,000 (about AUD 31, RBA rate 30 October 2026), children 3 to 10 IDR 250,000, same price every day (search snapshot).

lore.text: Local legend says Prambanan's thousand temples were raised in a single night for Princess Roro Jonggrang, who was turned to stone for tricking her suitor.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source
